newsitem.title: ALGERIA: Sonatrach, Repsol sign Halliburton deal.
newsitem.headline: Sonatrach, Repsol sign Halliburton deal.

text.p: Algeria's state oil and gas firm Sonatrach and a Spanish partner Repsol announced on Wednesday they had signed a $57 million deal with U.S. firm Halliburton to develop the Tifernine oilfield

The Algerian news agency APS said that under the contract, Brown and Root Condor -- a subsidiary of Sonatrach and Halliburton -- will develop Tifernine, some 600 km (375 miles) southeast of Hassi Messaoud, Algeria's main oilfield.
Brown and Root Condor will set up a collection network for 15 wells, a storage plant and installations aimed at treating 12,500 barrels of oil a day from the start of 1998.
APS said the contract was signed in Hassi Messaoud on Monday. The Tifernine field was discovered in 1993 by Sonatrach-Repsol.
